items.title: Superintelligent AI & the New Social Contract
items.base_title: Superintelligent AI & the New Social Contract
items.description: Explore generative AI, autonomous agents and superintelligence, including accountability, human autonomy, legal personhood and the legal and policy choices surrounding advanced AI.
items.planning_note: Counts as a LIT concentration elective. Course number was not included in the announcement.

items.title: Knowledge Technology for Factual Analysis
items.description: Use AI and other technologies to organize evidence and arguments. Hands-on work includes Wigmore diagrams and argument maps, with a weekly in-person class and independent project work.
items.planning_note: Counts as a LIT elective and toward the experiential learning and Race, Equity, and Law (REAL) requirements. Expect an average of eight hours of work outside class each week.
